responsibility: Source, emitted output and release artifact correspondence
stage: Confirmed local drift, not demonstrated deployment defect
trigger: A self-consistent old manifest or successful stale import is accepted as the current source/library graph.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Retain accepted source-level guards and historical narrow receipts; qualify a privately emitted current-source closure before its delivery/adoption claim. Hash source, tool/lock inputs, emitted bytes, packed files and resolved consumer paths separately.

trigger: Node root imports eagerly link development/MCP dependencies before a particular API is called.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Measure/qualify exact public entries with their declared external closure. Consider only caller-proved split/lazy simplification, preserving API/first-error order. Missing deliberately omitted fixture dependencies is not an install defect.

responsibility: Public deep exports versus physical/version layout
stage: Pinned upgrade coupling, no blanket deep-import ban
trigger: Bundler version/path/export-object assertions and cookie/CSV API/error/output profiles outlive a pinned library version.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Distinguish public subpaths from private/layout reads. Requalify entry closure, error identity, cookie attribute order and outputs for any selected upgrade; root SDK missing files are not Can-selected deep-entry failures.

responsibility: Vendor rewriting, dynamic graph and repeated class identity
trigger: Whole producer trees, source-literal rewrites and separately bundled SDK/identity copies change under a producer/Bun upgrade.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Trace actual runtime import targets and error crossings; preserve trusted versus strict-artifact admission. Static link success/markers cannot prove computed targets or instanceof compatibility. No actual crossing failure claimed.

stage: Source-only finite profile; selected installations absent
trigger: Lexer kind/span values, Unicode/LF projection, remapping source identities and generated wrapper shape change.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Use the frozen import/map/diagnostic profiles and actual staged Node/workerd/installed callers. Simplification proposals remain subordinate to behavior authority; do not adopt a library default as policy.

responsibility: Generated Wasm ABI, instance and asset ownership
stage: Current source controls plus narrow raw asset probes
trigger: Generated glue/export shapes, initialization order, first-instance cache or host globals change.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Preserve one admitted asset/instance, exact ABI/toolchain/generated output correspondence, first-init failure and later changed-input refusal on current bindings. Raw initSync or ABI1/add-int3 is not backend/profile/consumer adoption.

responsibility: Host and native tool installation requirements
stage: Platform-specific support, unrun current host matrix
trigger: Node floor/condition, native comparison primitive, workerd OS/arch optional binary or actual Bun version differs.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Qualify earliest declared Node and real authenticated Worker/browser routes plus native platform installation. Direct Bun APIs need their own host/version evidence; task wrapper guards do not cover all callers.

responsibility: Installed CLI versus installed bundle API
stage: Documented checkout path; dist-only CLI build limitation
trigger: CLI build interprets dist parent as repository and reads compiler/Cargo.toml and packages directories.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Keep built-checkout support separate from a dist-only installed CLI claim. Public producer exports can be installed-compatible without making CLI build installed-compatible. Do not invent release-fact fallback policy.

trigger: Verified resources or an exported initializer/factory are credited as a mounted full browser/Worker workflow.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Join actual resource routes, page CSS/module/HTMX/context initialization, selected runtime and producer/consumer workflow. Asset gather/hash/refusal and a401/ABI vector/factory import remain narrower. Current WindowLike requires visibilityState and is passed as polling visibility, while the real DOM owns it on Document. A raw window is not that supplied contract; reconcile actual document visibility before initializer acceptance. Injected valid ports remain valid; no deployed hidden-page defect is claimed.

responsibility: Registered native Work versus supported delivery consumer
stage: Native registration retained, no exported loader/selected consumer
trigger: Rust file registration or facts-only Node module import is accepted as full Work Rust backend delivery.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Retain registered finite decision evidence; require actual generated binding/ABI/asset loader, exact consumer, authority/order/errors, whole-call measurements and rollback before any stronger backend claim. No TS deletion/default switch.

responsibility: Native preparation inventory, ordering and release facts
stage: Human-held, current normal CLI TS path
trigger: Executable availability/handshake is mistaken for integrity/release; ordinary emit after native pack retains only binary/manifest and removes sidecars.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Keep availability/hash/target/toolchain/parity/economics/served closure/complete release inventory distinct. Reconcile build order at an authorized future release; held preparation does not block independent ready library work.

responsibility: SDK negotiation, schema and result/cancellation evolution
stage: Public API override coupling; current metadata use limited
trigger: SDK upgrade changes default initialize side effects, schema validator, post-effect result checks or cancellation/timeout assumptions.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Qualify Can-selected SDK entries and authenticated handlers. Replacement initialize bypasses default metadata storage; current stateless routes do not use it. AJV presence alone does not prove forbidden eval; outgoing timeout/wrapper abort does not bound owning effects.

responsibility: Multiple lock versions and delivery/tool profiles
stage: Metadata inventory, not duplicate production-byte proof
trigger: Lock duplicates or independent Cargo roots are treated as runtime duplication or forcibly collapsed.
required_qualification_or_proposed_simpl: Trace actual delivered closure first. Lock includes build/dev/types/indirect versions; compare same required outcomes/error/order across profiles before any dedupe. No dependency update selected here.
